newsitem.title: USA: Plymouth Rubber Co Q4 net income falls.
newsitem.headline: Plymouth Rubber Co Q4 net income falls.

text.p: NOTE (A): EPS adjusted to account for a 5 percent stock dividend on Class A and Class B common stock.
(B) Net income for fiscal 1995 Q4 reflects recapture of $819,000 of deferred tax valuation allowance, resulting in a $148,000 tax benefit, and a $825,000 before tax gain from litigation.
(C) Fiscal 1995 net income reflects recapture of $1,431,000 of deferred tax valuation allowance, resulting in a $42,000 tax provision, and pre-tax gains of $825,000 and $395,000 from litigation.
(D) Net income for fiscal 1996's fourth quarter reflects a $173,000 tax benefit.
(E) Net income for fiscal 1996 reflects the recapture of $1,873,000 of deferred tax valuation allowance, resulting in a $1,797,000 tax benefit.
